title: Athena - 3D VRM AI Assistant
shortDescription: Desktop AI assistant combining Electron, Three.js VRM rendering, LangGraph orchestration, and local speech services.
description: Athena is a desktop-first AI assistant that runs as an Electron application with a React/Vite renderer and a modular backend. The project combines a 3D avatar pipeline (VRM + FBX animation), local STT/TTS services, and a LangGraph-driven tool workflow for web search, weather, timers, and document-based retrieval.
myContributions: Built the Electron + React desktop architecture and IPC integration.
Implemented the 3D avatar runtime with VRM/FBX animation handling.
Integrated LangGraph-driven tool routing and local speech services.
